summary: Frontend-only E2E of Records by Arsonist auth wiring + onboarding wizard. Signup, dev-OTP verify, onboarding welcome, accounts hub, add-bank (HDFC preset ₹50,000 SAVINGS), add-card (ICICI preset ₹2,000 / ₹100,000), budgets (₹1,300 total), complete-setup landing on dashboard, reload persistence, and login-to-dashboard for an already-onboarded user ALL PASSED. Validation for weak password and wrong OTP also PASSED (auth-error shown from backend/UI). Google Sign-In button present, not clicked (per instruction). Rupee ₹ symbols confirmed on all account screens, no 'Plaid' text found, telemetry '0 LINKED' block absent. Fast-select presets exactly HDFC/ICICI/AXIS/SBI/OTHER on both bank and card screens. Bottom hub buttons ordered correctly (Add Accounts above Set Up Budgets).
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding-completed flag is stored only in localStorage as rba_onboarded_<userId>. If the same user logs in from a different device or after clearing site data, the onboarding wizard reappears. Consider persisting an onboarding_completed flag on the backend user profile so it survives cross-device/clear-storage logins. During test, login flow only routes straight to dashboard when the rba_onboarded_<userId> flag is preserved locally.

Logout is not exposed as a first-class action in the tested flows; testers had to manually clear localStorage keys (rba_access_token, rba_refresh_token, kinetic_ledger_active_user_id). A visible Logout affordance in the header/settings is recommended (may already exist in SettingsModal — was not verified in this run).
test_credentials: Fresh unique emails generated each run (alex_<random>@testrba.dev / Sup3r!SecretKey12). Dev OTP read from data-testid=otp-dev-hint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All auth+onboarding data-testids present and stable. Logout: clear localStorage keys rba_access_token, rba_refresh_token, kinetic_ledger_active_user_id (do NOT clear rba_onboarded_* if you want login to skip onboarding). Onboarding flag is per-user id from backend so re-signup creates a new id and re-onboards, which is expected.
